name: InitChildGroupObject
evidence: slot 0 of class 0x3B: after the base set-up stores FLT_MAX in +0x554, 200.0 in +0x55C and +0x560, 800 and 5000 and the vector tuning from D_00261320..D_00261358

name: LoadChildGroupObject
evidence: slot 10 of class 0x3B: runs the base step then func_00159478 to find its member at +0x5BC

name: CopyChildGroupObject
evidence: slot 9 of class 0x3B: runs the base copy and duplicates the 0x24-byte block at +0x680 with func_0018D568

name: StartChildGroupObject
evidence: slot 16 of class 0x3B: after the base step walks its children list and stores each class 0x27 child (up to 16) in arr, then allocates 0xC0 bytes at +0x68C when active

name: HandleChildGroupNotification
evidence: slot 13 of class 0x3B: after the base handler, message kind 0xA aimed at itself while +0x550 is 0 starts the delay clock

name: UpdateChildGroupObject
evidence: original assembly; slot 17 (+0x54) of class 0x3B, the update slot (UpdatePlacedObject, UpdateMaskedCollider)

name: RefreshChildGroupObjectContacts
evidence: clears the contact-pair flag 0x40 of the last entries, then for each active class 0x75 object whose bounds overlap the group's span stores the owner and the span's point, direction and dot, setting the pair flag again (at most four entries)

name: RunKeyedChildGroupEntry
evidence: slot 58 of class 0x3B: when active finds the entry with the given key in its table at +0x68C and passes it, its data and its value to func_00185D20

name: HandleChildGroupObjectContact
evidence: class 0x3B's slot at 0x100 (inherited by three classes, StopStandIn calls it as its base), the contact slot of LatchContactObject and the Compute...ContactValue methods; it calls RecordChildGroupPose

name: HandleChildGroupObjectEvent
evidence: original assembly; slot 45 (+0xC4) of class 0x3B, the event slot (HandleTriggerZoneEvent, HandleFlaggedObjectEvent)

name: RecordChildGroupPose
evidence: stores its argument at 0x670, copies the position at 0x140 to 0x610 and the frame at 0x150/0x160 to 0x650/0x660, and recomputes 0x620..0x640; the contact and event handlers and func_0013BF68 call it

name: StartChildGroupDelay
evidence: stores the clock D_0026185C plus the argument in +0x554 of a class 0x3B object

name: ApplyChildGroupKnockback
evidence: owner-message callback: pushes the hit object away from the group (direction normalised, scaled by two constants), constrains it with func_001BA2E8, calls the object's descriptor slot 36 with the vector and puts a kind-7 object in state 0x2B

name: ApplyChildGroupRepulsion
evidence: full update pass of a child group object: gathers the colliders in a sphere (or those in contact), and for each lighter free one computes an impulse from direction, mass, speed and distance falloff, adds random spin, sends owner messages to kind 5 objects and starts delays on others

name: GetChildGroupSoundParams
evidence: returns the pointer at the object's sound slot, setting it up with InitSoundParams first when it is 0 (as GetMaskedColliderSoundParams does)
